name: sarah
description: Count tokens, lines and function sizes per file and flag refactor candidates for AI agents
long_description: sarah measures tokens (exact tiktoken counts), lines and function sizes per file, and flags files, functions, types, imports and folders over the limits in sarah.toml. Give the tools absolute paths: the server's working directory is not your project.

tools.name: report
tools.description: Full report for a directory: totals, largest files and functions, warnings

tools.name: warnings
tools.description: Only the warnings, as JSON; changed_since limits them to a branch

tools.name: check_file
tools.description: One file's sizes, functions and warnings

tools.name: diff
tools.description: File, line, token and warning deltas since a git revision
